ai_summary: Aarvi Encon demonstrates strong operational growth, evidenced by a 14% 3-year revenue CAGR and increasing PAT, supported by diversified technical staffing services and a strong client base. However, the company operates with consistently low and fluctuating profit margins. A material impact and key red flag is the high level of trade receivables, which constituted over 50% of current assets in FY26, potentially straining working capital and cash flow efficiency.
